summary: The note previews the Family Movie Night at the Park, a free community event on Saturday, September 11, 2023, featuring an outdoor screening of the animated film "The Galactic Quest." It covers pre-movie activities, food, eco-friendly and safety measures, sponsors, and the community-building purpose of the evening, with quotes from organizers.
one_line: Preview of the free Family Movie Night at the Park on September 11, 2023, with activities, food, safety plans and community focus.
key_facts: Family Movie Night at the Park is scheduled for Saturday, September 11, 2023.
The featured film is "The Galactic Quest," an animated story about unity and adventure.
Pre-movie festivities begin at 6 PM, with face painting, crafts and interactive games.
Emily Thompson, chairwoman of the local Parks and Recreation Committee, helped organize the event and said "a community that plays together, stays together."
John Baker, an art teacher at the community's high school, will lead a workshop where kids make cardboard movie clappers.
Boy Scout Troop 42 will run its annual popcorn stand, popping kernels on the spot.
Food trucks at the perimeters will offer burgers, tacos, smoothies and ice cream.
The event has a high-definition outdoor screen and a state-of-the-art sound system.
Sarah Johnson, head of the local Sustainability Council, asks attendees to bring reusable containers for snacks.
Local police will secure the perimeter, and neighborhood watch volunteers led by David King will direct families and manage flow.
Entry is free for all; the committee found sponsors, including Linda and Bob Henderson, owners of Henderson's Hardware Store.
Photography enthusiasts from the local college will offer photos to capture family moments.
Local businesses and artists can showcase their services and work, creating a festive market vibe.
